reading: The selector is true for a model id containing gpt- but neither oss nor gpt-4. True publishes apply_patch and withholds edit and write; false publishes edit and write and withholds apply_patch. The rule is unchanged from OpenCode 1.19.3 to 1.19.5; only the registry wrapper and minified symbols changed. No provider participates in the edit-family decision. V1 parity still uses the captured mock/mock-model, so its apply_patch leg remains excluded. V2 apply_patch scenarios explicitly select openai/gpt-5-mock while other scenarios keep openai/mock-model by default. V2 disables the host patch plugin and AFT supplies the corresponding per-model gate.
